# GluFloat

> GluFloat is a Nigerian diabetes food app. It tells a person with diabetes whether a Nigerian food or meal is good to eat, how much to eat, and how often, using a green, yellow or red answer. It covers eba, amala, fufu, pounded yam, rice, plantain, beans, pap, soups and 1,400+ other Nigerian food names.

GluFloat is built for people in Nigeria managing type 2 diabetes, and for their families and health workers. It suggests a meal for breakfast, lunch and dinner, lets a person check any food or build a plate, keeps a record of what they ate and their own sugar test numbers, and makes a report they can send to their doctor on WhatsApp. The food advice uses measured glycaemic index values for Nigerian staples where they exist.

GluFloat does not diagnose, treat or cure diabetes. It gives food guidance and does not replace a doctor or dietitian.

- [Home](https://www.glufloat.com/): what GluFloat does, and the free 7-day trial
- [About](https://www.glufloat.com/about): who is behind GluFloat
